nodes.name: ActivityDock.jsx
nodes.summary: Floating background-activity dock that mounts in the CornerCV6 shell and follows across every screen, showing live Claude agent sessions from /api/dashboard/active-agents with a sample fallback when idle.
nodes.languageNotes: Held-C control set (Pause/Back/Finish) kept honestly disabled until the backend wires them, per the no-fake-UI rule.

nodes.name: CornerCV6.jsx
nodes.summary: Root entry component for the CV6 dashboard surface that /dashboard now renders; mounts every screen (Home, Chat, Support, Command, Tracker, LiveScribe, Search) as a fill-in template fed real data, with a view-machine router and demo fixtures.
nodes.languageNotes: Screens are composed by filling Claude Design HTML templates (imported ?raw) through TemplateScreen rather than hand-drawn JSX; CV4 stays reachable at ?cv4=1 as a fallback.

nodes.name: LiveScribe.jsx
nodes.summary: Live Scribe meeting-capture tool screen (the 8th nav tool), grafted from the design-system livescribe template and driven by the useLiveScribe hook for real 15s-chunk audio recording and Gemini transcription.

nodes.name: NewComposer.jsx
nodes.summary: The single start-a-mission / new-project creation overlay for the whole surface, opened from every entry point (Home and Organize on both breakpoints) and hitting createMissionInProject / createProjectFromHome.
nodes.languageNotes: Uncontrolled text fields ride the DOM (.is-on) plus a ref instead of setState so a realtime data tick cannot wipe the overlay mid-edit; project/agent lists are frozen at open time.

nodes.name: Search.jsx
nodes.summary: Global command-K search (mobile field + desktop palette) built in React because it is input-driven; filters Rooms and Missions client-side from the same hooks Home and Chat use and opens the selected room.

nodes.name: SharedNav.jsx
nodes.summary: The one canonical navigation, rendered as a desktop tool bar and a mobile drawer that both read the same ordered NAV_TOOLS list so icons, order, and active state never drift between screens.
nodes.languageNotes: Only tools flagged wired render, so there are no dead taps; the full 8-tool list is the design's source of truth.

nodes.name: SupportDesktop.jsx
nodes.summary: Desktop Support screen: an Open/Waiting inbox rail plus an email-review pane with AI summary, original email, suggested actions, and a reply composer, where every control is wired to a real backend (send-staged, reply, resolve, tracker, assign).

nodes.name: SupportThread.jsx
nodes.summary: Conversation card rendering the real Gmail chain behind one support ask from /api/support/thread — every inbound and outbound message in order, latest expanded and earlier ones collapsed, with a single-message fallback when no thread exists.

nodes.name: agentTitles.js
nodes.summary: Central agent-privacy map: exposes agents as role titles rather than persona names everywhere (roster, Catch Up feed, headers), via the AGENT_TITLES slug-to-title map and the ordered DASHBOARD_AGENTS set.

nodes.name: ActivityDock
nodes.summary: Renders the floating activity dock: pulls live agent jobs via useCommand, maps each job kind to a tint, resolves role titles via titleForAgent, and shows a labelled sample job when nothing is running.

nodes.name: roomSummarySentences
nodes.summary: Turns a project's stored summary markdown into a clean one-or-two sentence room blurb for the catch-up card, stripping markdown and collapsing whitespace.

nodes.name: composeScreen
nodes.summary: Composes a full desktop screen by selecting the correct raw HTML template and binding it to real data for the template engine to fill in.

nodes.name: composeChatMobile
nodes.summary: Builds the mobile chat screen composition, wiring the mobile chat template to the active room's thread data.

nodes.name: Cv6QuickThread
nodes.summary: Quick inline chat thread component used in Home's conversation column, rendering a compact live message view for the selected room.

nodes.name: InlineBubbleThread
nodes.summary: One of the CV6 chat message renderers, drawing an inline bubble-style thread for a room's messages.

nodes.name: CatchUpModal
nodes.summary: Modal that surfaces the needs-you Catch Up items, letting the user review and act on rooms that require attention.

nodes.name: HomeFilesPanel
nodes.summary: Files panel shown on the Home screen, listing recent room files and deliverables and letting the user open or preview them.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.summary: The Home front-door screen: a desktop three-column and mobile layout showing real rooms, agents, and the needs-you Catch Up, wiring the home templates to useHome data and handling navigation, creation, and file interactions.

nodes.name: ChatList
nodes.summary: Renders the all-rooms conversation list screen from the chat-list template bound to useChatList data.

nodes.name: SupportInbox
nodes.summary: Support inbox screen reachable from the nav, binding the support-inbox template to useSupportInbox data and routing into the support thread review pane.

nodes.name: Chat
nodes.summary: Chat screen wrapper that mounts the desktop or mobile chat surface for the selected room and wires its lifecycle and thread data.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Command screen combining the live activity dock and a 24h room ledger, bound to useCommand data with an honest goal/checklist that avoids invented steps.

nodes.name: Tracker
nodes.summary: Bug Tracker screen backed by the real /api/dashboard/cv6-bugs source via useTrackerBugs, rendering the tracker template with severity/priority mapping and status filtering.

nodes.name: ScreenBoundary
nodes.summary: React error boundary wrapping each mounted screen so a render failure in one template surfaces a fallback instead of crashing the whole dashboard shell.

nodes.name: CornerCV6
nodes.summary: Default-exported root component: owns the view-machine state, reads initial view and targets from the URL, mounts the SharedNav plus ActivityDock, and routes to the active screen inside a ScreenBoundary.

nodes.name: composeLiveScribe
nodes.summary: Builds the LiveScribe screen composition, binding the livescribe HTML template to the hook's session state and honestly disabling controls that have no backend.

nodes.name: LiveScribe
nodes.summary: Default-exported LiveScribe tool component that mounts the template via TemplateScreen and drives capture, transcription, and save through the useLiveScribe hook.

nodes.name: NewComposer
nodes.summary: Default-exported creation overlay with two modes (start a mission / new project) that submits to createMissionInProject or createProjectFromHome, using DOM-driven uncontrolled fields to survive realtime re-binds.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.summary: Default-exported global search component that filters rooms and missions client-side on every keystroke and opens the chosen result, rendering a mobile field or desktop palette per breakpoint.

nodes.name: DesktopNav
nodes.summary: Desktop top tool bar form of the shared nav, rendering the wired NAV_TOOLS entries with active-state and dispatching the picked route to onPick.

nodes.name: MobileNav
nodes.summary: Mobile drawer form of the shared nav, rendering the same ordered NAV_TOOLS list so mobile and desktop navigation never drift.

nodes.name: normalizeLinks
nodes.summary: Exported helper that normalizes a set of links into a consistent shape for the support review pane and its consumers.

nodes.name: InboxRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single Open/Waiting inbox rail row (sender, subject, tint, latency) selectable to open its email-review pane.

nodes.name: useSupportActivity
nodes.summary: Hook tracking live agent activity on the support desk so the review pane can show what an assigned agent is currently doing on a ticket.

nodes.name: AgentWorkPanel
nodes.summary: Panel showing the assigned agent's in-progress work on a support ticket, driven by useSupportActivity.

nodes.name: SupportDesktop
nodes.summary: Default-exported desktop Support screen orchestrating the inbox rail, the email-review pane (summary, thread, suggested actions, composer), and wired send/resolve/tracker/assign actions.

nodes.name: ThreadMessage
nodes.summary: Renders one message in the support Gmail chain, expandable/collapsible with sender, first line, relative time, and an accent rail plus AOM-sent tag for our outbound side.

nodes.name: SupportThread
nodes.summary: Default-exported conversation card that fetches the real Gmail thread from /api/support/thread with a bounded abort, renders it in order, and falls back to a single-message card when no thread exists.

nodes.name: titleForAgent
nodes.summary: Exported resolver mapping an agent slug to its public role title so a persona name never leaks into the UI.

nodes.name: curateTitledAgents
nodes.summary: Exported curator that builds the ordered, title-only agent set for Home's Agents accordion, folding live and known agents into the roster while keeping the privacy doctrine.

nodes.name: blockSchema.js
nodes.summary: Defines the CV6 chat message block schema: the BLOCK_TYPES catalog (step, success, snag, question, data, summary, code, choice, gallery, etc.) plus small factory helpers to build each block, layered additively on top of a message's plain text.
nodes.languageNotes: Blocks render after plain text (never replacing it), keeping the chat system additive so it never breaks plain-text conversation.

nodes.name: resultLinks.js
nodes.summary: Decides which links in an agent message deserve a tappable card, pulling from the structured completion payload first and then any http(s) URL in the agent's text so completed web work always lands as a card rather than a bare URL.

nodes.name: useCommandTracker.js
nodes.summary: Provides the real data hooks behind the Command screen (live agent activity dock + 24h room ledger via useCommand) and the Tracker screen (the real CV6 bug list via useTrackerBugs), with no fabricated data.
nodes.languageNotes: The focused goal/checklist binds to an honest summary rather than invented steps because no structured source exists yet.

nodes.name: useDemoBlocks.js
nodes.summary: Demo block feed for exercising CV6 chat block rendering, assembling a clearly-labelled DEMO stream from the blockSchema factories, activated via ?demo=blocks so it can never be mistaken for real data.

nodes.name: useHomeData.js
nodes.summary: Shapes the real Home-screen data (agents, projects, the needs-you Catch Up) from the shared useDataPipe context into the Home fill-in templates, and exposes chat-list, project-mission, and creation helpers used across the surface.
nodes.languageNotes: Binds the conversation column's goal to honest empties instead of the design's sample text because agent run goal/step data is not exposed yet.

nodes.name: useLiveScribe.js
nodes.summary: Live Scribe capture hook that records audio in 15-second chunks, transcribes each via Gemini, extracts action items and decisions every third chunk, and saves the finished session to cm_state, reporting template-friendly state.
nodes.languageNotes: Chunked base64 conversion replaced an argument-spread that threw RangeError on real chunks; refs plus a pending-work queue fix stale timestamps and the final-chunk save race (2026-07-06 fix).

nodes.name: useRoomThread.js
nodes.summary: Shapes one room's real conversation from /api/dashboard/supabase-messages into the agent-chat Turn contract (oldest to newest), and exposes goal-thread and room-plan hooks plus work-step-to-block injection for the chat surface.

nodes.name: useSupportInbox.js
nodes.summary: Wires the real support flow into the { state, data } contract the support-inbox template expects, filtering out no-reply senders and reporting loading/empty/error honestly instead of faking rows.

nodes.name: DataContext.jsx
nodes.summary: Single shared data source for the whole dashboard: one DataProvider wraps useDataPipe at the top level and one CommandProvider wraps useCommand/useTrackerBugs, collapsing 6+ redundant polling loops and Supabase subscriptions into one and adding client-side caching.
nodes.languageNotes: Consumer hooks degrade gracefully with warned empty defaults when used outside their provider.

nodes.name: extractLinkCards
nodes.summary: Exported extractor that pulls cardable link cards from an agent message, preferring the structured completion payload and falling back to shared http(s) URLs in the text.

nodes.name: stripTrailingCardUrl
nodes.summary: Exported helper that removes a trailing URL from message text once it has been lifted into a card, so the link is not duplicated in both the text and the card.

nodes.name: shapeLoopRow
nodes.summary: Shapes a routine/loop room's raw state into a ledger row with cadence, failing status, and duration labels for the Command screen.

nodes.name: shapeCommand
nodes.summary: Core shaper that transforms raw agent activity, room, and message data into the Command screen's activity dock plus 24h ledger structure, resolving titles, status, goals, and open questions.

nodes.name: useCommand
nodes.summary: Exported hook powering the Command screen and the activity dock: pulls live agent sessions and recent-room messages, shapes them via shapeCommand, and manages selection, filtering, and goal editing.

nodes.name: useTrackerBugs
nodes.summary: Exported hook backing the Tracker screen with the real CV6 bug list from /api/dashboard/cv6-bugs, shaping tickets with severity-to-priority mapping and status.

nodes.name: useDemoBlocks
nodes.summary: Exported hook that assembles a clearly-labelled DEMO block stream from the blockSchema factories to exercise every CV6 chat block renderer.

nodes.name: useDemoBlocksFeed
nodes.summary: Exported thin wrapper that exposes the demo block stream as a feed for CornerCV6 to inject when ?demo=blocks is active.

nodes.name: shapeHome
nodes.summary: Shapes agents, projects, and the needs-you Catch Up from the data pipe into the Home template's { state, data } contract, resolving agent titles and honest empties for unavailable goal data.

nodes.name: useHome
nodes.summary: Exported Home hook that reads the shared data context and returns the shaped Home data for the Home screen.

nodes.name: shapeChatList
nodes.summary: Shapes rooms into the all-rooms chat-list structure with status, tint, and last-line preview for the chat-list template and Search.

nodes.name: useChatList
nodes.summary: Exported hook returning the shaped all-rooms chat list, consumed by the ChatList screen and global Search.

nodes.name: shapeProjectState
nodes.summary: Exported shaper mapping a project's raw rooms and missions into the project-state structure used by Organize and the composer.

nodes.name: createMissionInProject
nodes.summary: Exported action that creates a new mission inside a project via the create-mission-from-drawer backend, used by the NewComposer overlay.

nodes.name: createProjectFromHome
nodes.summary: Exported action that creates a new project via the create-project-from-chat backend, used by the NewComposer overlay's new-project mode.

nodes.name: useProjectMissions
nodes.summary: Exported hook returning a project's missions shaped for consumers like Organize and Search.

nodes.name: useLiveScribe
nodes.summary: Exported meeting-capture hook: records 15s audio chunks, transcribes each via Gemini, periodically extracts action items and decisions, tracks live transcript state, and awaits outstanding transcriptions before saving the session.

nodes.name: injectWorkSteps
nodes.summary: Reroutes plain agent replies that carry work steps into the structured blocks path, converting work steps into step blocks so the goal thread renders them.

nodes.name: useRoomThread
nodes.summary: Exported hook that loads and live-subscribes to one room's real message thread from the supabase-messages endpoint, shaping messages into Turn elements with link cards, titles, and time formatting.

nodes.name: useGoalThread
nodes.summary: Exported hook exposing the room's goal-thread view (live steps and structured blocks) for the goal thread body.

nodes.name: useRoomPlan
nodes.summary: Exported hook that derives the room's plan/checklist state from its thread for the plan panel.

nodes.name: latencyLabel
nodes.summary: Exported helper that turns an elapsed time into a human latency label for support inbox rows.

nodes.name: parseWishMessage
nodes.summary: Parses a raw support wish message into structured fields (summary bullets and reply options) for the review pane.

nodes.name: useSupportInbox
nodes.summary: Exported hook that loads the real support inbox into the template's { state, data } contract, filtering no-reply senders and reporting loading/empty/error honestly.

nodes.name: DataProvider
nodes.summary: Exported provider that instantiates useDataPipe once at the top level and exposes its result through DataContext so every screen shares one polling loop and subscription set.

nodes.name: CommandProvider
nodes.summary: Exported provider that instantiates useCommand and useTrackerBugs once at the top level and holds selection/filter/goal-edit state so it persists across navigations.

nodes.name: useDataContext
nodes.summary: Exported consumer hook returning the shared data-pipe result, degrading to warned empty defaults when used outside DataProvider.

nodes.name: useCommandContext
nodes.summary: Exported consumer hook returning the shared command/tracker state and setters, degrading to warned empty defaults when used outside CommandProvider.

nodes.name: Organize.jsx
nodes.summary: Viewport router for the CV6 Organize tool; mounts OrganizeDesktop or OrganizeMobile based on a max-width:899px media query and forwards nav/search/assign props.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin dispatcher using a useMediaQuery hook; the 900px breakpoint is the app-wide tablet rule.

nodes.name: OrganizeDesktop.jsx
nodes.summary: Desktop layout for the Organize tool that binds the useOrganize data hook to the wired template, wiring the file tree, doc/media viewers, pins, review-changes overlay, and tree context menu.

nodes.name: OrganizeMobile.jsx
nodes.summary: Mobile layout for the Organize tool with picker/browse/view screens; composes each screen from the useOrganize data and reuses the desktop viewers, pins, and composer.

nodes.name: Review.jsx
nodes.summary: Mobile/compact Review tool screen that composes the deliverables review queue from the useReview hook and wires approve, request-changes, and pin-comment interactions.

nodes.name: ReviewChanges.jsx
nodes.summary: Overlay that compiles a reviewer's requested changes (comments and pins) into a single change list before it is sent back to the agent as a decision event.

nodes.name: ReviewDesktop.jsx
nodes.summary: Desktop layout for the Review tool that binds the useReview queue to the wired template and wires deliverable viewing, pin comments, request-changes overlay, and the tree context menu.

nodes.name: ReviewPins.jsx
nodes.summary: Pin-comment UI layer for the Review viewer; provides the useReviewPinUI hook and a PinPopover portal for placing point comments on docs, images, and video frames.

nodes.name: TreeContextMenu.jsx
nodes.summary: Right-click / long-press context menu shared by Home, Organize, and Review project/mission rows; exposes the useTreeContextMenu hook plus rename, move, archive, and create node actions against the dashboard API.
nodes.languageNotes: Menu, move picker, and rename dialog are React portals on document.body so template rebuilds cannot touch them; all row listening is delegated from a stable wrapper ref.

nodes.name: Organize
nodes.summary: Default Organize component that picks the mobile or desktop layout by the 899px media query and forwards nav, search, and file-assignment callbacks.

nodes.name: composeOrganize
nodes.summary: Shapes raw useOrganize data into the props/DOM contract expected by the wired Organize template for a given screen name.

nodes.name: buildWaitingMap
nodes.summary: Builds a lookup map of items that are waiting on a decision, keyed for quick badge/state rendering in the Organize tree.

nodes.name: buildDecidedMap
nodes.summary: Builds a lookup map of already-decided items so the tree can mark resolved files distinctly from waiting ones.

nodes.name: OrganizeDesktop
nodes.summary: Main desktop Organize component that consumes useOrganize/usePins/useReview, mounts the doc and media viewers, and delegates row actions to the tree context menu and change overlays.

nodes.name: finalizeScreen
nodes.summary: Finalizes a composed mobile Organize screen DOM, wiring the ready element and cleaning up transient template state before render.

nodes.name: composeBrowse
nodes.summary: Composes the mobile browse screen from raw Organize data, laying out the file/mission list the user taps into.

nodes.name: OrganizeMobile
nodes.summary: Main mobile Organize component that stacks picker, browse, and view screens over the useOrganize data and reuses the shared doc/media viewers and pins.

nodes.name: composeReviewScreen
nodes.summary: Shapes raw useReview data into the review screen's template contract, laying out the queue, deliverable body, and decision controls.

nodes.name: Review
nodes.summary: Main compact Review component that binds the useReview deliverables queue, renders the viewer with pin comments, and wires approve / request-changes decisions.

nodes.name: compileChanges
nodes.summary: Aggregates the reviewer's comments and pin annotations into a single ordered change list payload for the request-changes decision event.

nodes.name: ReviewChangesOverlay
nodes.summary: Overlay component that shows the compiled requested changes and lets the reviewer confirm and send them back to the agent as a decision.

nodes.name: composeDesktopReview
nodes.summary: Shapes raw useReview data into the desktop review template contract, laying out the queue panel, deliverable viewer, and decision controls.

nodes.name: ReviewDesktop
nodes.summary: Main desktop Review component that binds the useReview queue, mounts the deliverable viewers with pin comments, and wires request-changes overlay and tree context menu.

nodes.name: useReviewPinUI
nodes.summary: Hook that manages point-comment placement in the Review viewer: hit-testing clicks on docs/images/video frames, clamping marker positions, and driving the PinPopover.

nodes.name: PinPopover
nodes.summary: Portal popover component anchored to a pin marker for entering or editing a point-comment's text.

nodes.name: useTreeContextMenu
nodes.summary: Hook that wires right-click and long-press context menus to a surface's stable wrapper ref, resolving the hit row to a record and portaling the menu, move picker, and rename dialog.

nodes.name: renameNode
nodes.summary: Sends an authenticated request to rename a project/mission node's display name (slug and folder unchanged) via the dashboard API.

nodes.name: archiveNode
nodes.summary: Sends an authenticated request to archive a project/mission node via the dashboard API.

nodes.name: moveNode
nodes.summary: Sends an authenticated request to move a mission node under a different destination project via the dashboard API.

nodes.name: createNode
nodes.summary: Sends an authenticated request to create a new project/mission node under a target parent via the dashboard API.

nodes.name: findMissionNode
nodes.summary: Walks the project tree to locate a mission node by its full slug or leaf slug.

nodes.name: slugifyName
nodes.summary: Normalizes a human display name into a URL/folder-safe slug for new tree nodes.

nodes.name: docxDocView.js
nodes.summary: Docx preview helper for Organize/Review viewers; renders a shell, sanitizes converted HTML, and provides the useDocxDocs hook that hydrates .docx nodes in the wrapper.

nodes.name: htmlDocView.js
nodes.summary: HTML file preview helper that rewrites relative asset URLs and CSS references for safe in-viewer rendering and provides the useHtmlDocs hook to hydrate .html preview nodes.

nodes.name: mediaFallback.js
nodes.summary: Installs a single global media-error handler that swaps a failed video/audio/img element in place for a 'Couldn't load / Retry' card with a cache-busted retry, shared by Organize and Review previews.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds the error card with real DOM and listeners (no nested-attribute string escaping) and does not wrap the element, so ReviewPins' scrub-bar host lookup stays intact.

nodes.name: pdfDocView.js
nodes.summary: PDF preview helper that renders a viewer shell and provides the usePdfDocs hook to hydrate and dispose PDF preview nodes in the Organize/Review wrappers.

nodes.name: useOrganize.js
nodes.summary: Core Organize data hook that reads the project_files disk mirror metadata, lazily fetches and previews file content (markdown, images, PDFs, media), and shapes it to the wired Organize template contract.
nodes.languageNotes: Metadata-only listing so a 7k-file world never ships all its text; content fetched lazily on open and cached, with video streaming direct off the rag tunnel rather than the Vercel raw proxy.

nodes.name: usePins.js
nodes.summary: Hook managing pin-comment state for the Review tool, persisting point comments (x/y fractions plus optional video time) to the review-comments API so they survive refresh and reach the agent's fix-list.

nodes.name: useReview.js
nodes.summary: Core Review data hook that loads the real deliverables queue from the review-queue API, builds each deliverable's rendered body, groups sequences, and wires approve / request-changes as real decision events.
nodes.languageNotes: Renders deliverable bodies via marked (gfm) and shares the doc/media view helpers and agent-title curation; no fake data, all decisions are real events.

nodes.name: sanitize
nodes.summary: Sanitizes converted docx HTML before injection into the preview, stripping unsafe markup.

nodes.name: hydrateOne
nodes.summary: Fetches and converts a single .docx source, sanitizes the HTML, and injects it into the preview node while tracking it in the registry.

nodes.name: useDocxDocs
nodes.summary: Hook that scans the wrapper ref for pending docx preview nodes each tick and hydrates them, maintaining a registry across re-renders.

nodes.name: assetUrl
nodes.summary: Resolves a relative asset reference inside a previewed HTML file to an absolute in-viewer URL, passing through already-absolute URLs.

nodes.name: rewriteHtmlForPreview
nodes.summary: Rewrites a raw HTML source's asset and CSS URLs to viewer-safe paths so the file previews correctly without breaking relative references.

nodes.name: hydrateOne
nodes.summary: Fetches a single HTML file, rewrites it for preview, and injects it into the preview node while registering it for cleanup.

nodes.name: useHtmlDocs
nodes.summary: Hook that scans the wrapper ref for pending HTML preview nodes and hydrates them each tick, maintaining a registry across re-renders.

nodes.name: installMediaErr
nodes.summary: Installs the global window.__cornerMediaErr handler that replaces a failed media element in place with a visible 'Couldn't load / Retry' card and a cache-busted retry.

nodes.name: mediaAttrs
nodes.summary: Returns the shared inline attributes (including the onerror hook) to attach to a media element so load failures route to the global fallback card.

nodes.name: hydrateOne
nodes.summary: Loads and renders a single PDF into its preview node, wiring the viewer and tracking the entry in the registry for later disposal.

nodes.name: usePdfDocs
nodes.summary: Hook that scans the wrapper ref for pending PDF preview nodes, hydrates them, and disposes them on cleanup, maintaining a registry across re-renders.

nodes.name: parseMarkdown
nodes.summary: Renders markdown file content to safe preview HTML, handling inline formatting and escaped hrefs for the Organize viewer.

nodes.name: nonTextPreview
nodes.summary: Builds a placeholder preview card for non-text files (by name and detected kind) that cannot be rendered inline.

nodes.name: useOrganize
nodes.summary: Main Organize hook that loads the project_files disk mirror, tracks selection and open state, lazily fetches/caches and previews file content, and exposes the shaped data the Organize screens bind to.

nodes.name: toPin
nodes.summary: Maps a stored review-comment row into the pin shape the template binds (index, x/y in percent, text, optional video time).

nodes.name: usePins
nodes.summary: Hook that loads, adds, and persists pin point-comments for a deliverable against the review-comments API so annotations survive refresh and reach the agent.

nodes.name: downloadDeliverable
nodes.summary: Fetches a deliverable's bytes through an authenticated request and triggers a browser download of the file.

nodes.name: buildDeliverableBody
nodes.summary: Builds the rendered HTML body for a review deliverable by type, dispatching to the markdown/doc/media view helpers and wiring media-wait loaders and fallbacks.

nodes.name: groupSequences
nodes.summary: Groups related deliverable items into sequences so multi-part outputs render together in the review queue.

nodes.name: typeKeyOf
nodes.summary: Derives a canonical deliverable type key from a file name and MIME type to drive labels, glyphs, and body rendering.

nodes.name: reviewItemsFromFiles
nodes.summary: Transforms raw file rows into review queue items, assigning type, labels, thumbnails, and tint for the queue panel.

nodes.name: mapQueueItem
nodes.summary: Maps a raw queue row into the full review item the template binds, resolving open state, agent title, body, and decision affordances.

nodes.name: useReview
nodes.summary: Main Review hook that loads the deliverables queue with search/sort, opens and renders deliverable bodies, and wires approve and request-changes as real decision events.

nodes.name: useReviewWaitingCount
nodes.summary: Lightweight hook that returns the count of deliverables waiting on a review decision, used for the nav badge.

nodes.name: BlockRenderer.jsx
nodes.summary: Structured-block rendering library for CV6 chat: a `Result` dispatcher plus one component per agent block type (email, summary, artifact, data table, code diff, gallery, question, confirm) and shared `ActionChips`.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file block registry — Result switches on block.type to pick the matching sub-component.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.summary: Dispatcher that maps an agent block's `type` to the correct block component (email, summary, artifact, data, code, gallery, etc.) and forwards onAction.

nodes.name: ActionChips
nodes.summary: Renders a row of tappable action chips from a block's actions array and invokes onAction when a chip is pressed.

nodes.name: EmailBlock
nodes.summary: Renders an email preview block with sender avatar, subject, body and attachment chips that open in a new window.

nodes.name: SummaryBlock
nodes.summary: Renders a summary block with a title, bullet list, and optional trailing action chips.

nodes.name: ArtifactBlock
nodes.summary: Renders an artifact/deliverable card that opens in the in-app review canvas via ReviewCtx, or opens a real URL directly when no review surface is provided.

nodes.name: DataBlock
nodes.summary: Renders tabular agent data with a table/bar-chart toggle, normalizing rows and computing bar heights against the max metric.

nodes.name: CodeBlock
nodes.summary: Renders a collapsible code/diff block with language label, +/- added/removed counts, and a copy-to-clipboard control.

nodes.name: ChatDesktop.jsx
nodes.summary: Desktop CV6 chat surface: three-pane layout with room/project navigation, a files shelf, and the message thread, backed by room-library aggregation and agent-control actions (handoff, pause, retask).
nodes.languageNotes: Aggregates chat uploads, project-files API results, and links into a single deduped file shelf.

nodes.name: ChatDesktop
nodes.summary: Top-level desktop chat container wiring room/goal thread data, agent picker, file upload, agent-control commands, and the composer into the desktop layout.

nodes.name: useRoomLibrary
nodes.summary: Hook that fetches project files and chat uploads, merges them with conversation files and extracted links, dedupes, and returns a sorted room file shelf.

nodes.name: FilesShelf
nodes.summary: Renders the room files shelf with type-pill filtering, truncation controls, and per-item review/open actions.

nodes.name: shelfItems
nodes.summary: Derives file and link shelf items from a message list, classifying file kinds and extracting URLs, then sorts by timestamp.

nodes.name: ChatGoalThread.jsx
nodes.summary: The Goal Thread rendering core: turns agent blocks and live steps into a structured work timeline (step rows, work-done cards, plan panel, proposals) and re-declares the block components plus the Send/Review contexts.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines SendCtx/ReviewCtx React contexts consumed by BlockRenderer and MessageThread; carries its own block-component copies.

nodes.name: ChatGoalThread
nodes.summary: Top-level goal-thread component that composes the goal body, plan panel, and agent blocks for a room's active goal.

nodes.name: GoalThreadBody
nodes.summary: Renders the collapsible body of a goal thread — the ordered list of step/block rows for a goal, optionally collapsed by default.

nodes.name: PlanPanel
nodes.summary: Renders the plan panel with plan rows, proposal rows, and approve/handoff controls for an agent's proposed plan.

nodes.name: WorkDoneCard
nodes.summary: Renders a completed-work summary card for a finished goal, folding its blocks into a compact done state.

nodes.name: AgentBlocks
nodes.summary: Renders the sequence of agent output blocks for a goal via the goal-thread block components.

nodes.name: WorkingTurn
nodes.summary: Renders the live 'working' turn for a room by converting live steps into blocks and showing in-progress step rows.

nodes.name: buildSteps
nodes.summary: Transforms an array of agent blocks into an ordered list of thread step descriptors used to render the goal timeline.

nodes.name: liveStepsToBlocks
nodes.summary: Converts live agent step events into renderable block objects so in-flight work displays with the same components as final output.

nodes.name: StepRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single goal-thread step row with an action glyph, label, and nested result blocks for that step.

nodes.name: ChatLifecycle.jsx
nodes.summary: Mobile/lifecycle chat orchestrator that assembles the full chat experience — day-grouped messages, goal turns, file galleries, dictation, room files sheet, and the composer — pulling renderers from the other CV6 chat modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Central integration point importing BlockRenderer, ChatGoalThread, ChatDesktop, MessageThread, Cv6FullComposer, and useDictation.

nodes.name: ChatLifecycle
nodes.summary: Main chat lifecycle component that renders the message thread, goal state, room files sheet, dictation-enabled composer, and wires send/review handlers.

nodes.name: FileGallery
nodes.summary: Renders an in-thread gallery of file/image attachments with glyphs, sizes, and open actions.

nodes.name: Cv6FullComposer.jsx
nodes.summary: The full CV6 message composer: a portal-mounted input experience with attachments, recording, voice mode, and slash commands, wrapped in an error-boundary class with read-only and mini fallbacks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses createPortal to mount into a host node; class component serves as an error boundary around the functional inner composer.

nodes.name: Cv6FullComposer
nodes.summary: Error-boundary class component wrapping the inner composer, falling back to a read-only composer when the input experience throws.

nodes.name: Cv6FullComposerInner
nodes.summary: The functional composer body handling draft state, attachments, recording, voice mode, and slash-command input via the Cv6InputBar.

nodes.name: Cv6InputBar.jsx
nodes.summary: The CV6 chat input bar: text field with slash-command autocomplete, image-tool and integrations pickers, paste-chip handling, and a commands menu.

nodes.name: Cv6InputBar
nodes.summary: Input-bar component managing the text field, slash-command autocomplete, integrations modal, paste chips, and file-open trigger.

nodes.name: CommandsMenu
nodes.summary: Popover menu listing available slash/command actions and image tools for the input bar.

nodes.name: MessageAttachments.jsx
nodes.summary: Renders message attachments — single images, image galleries with a lightbox, and file collections with download/review actions — dispatched by attachment shape.

nodes.name: MessageAttachments
nodes.summary: Dispatcher that picks the right attachment renderer (single image, gallery, or file collection) for a message's attachments.

nodes.name: FileCollection
nodes.summary: Renders a list of non-image file attachments with kind glyphs, sizes, and download/review controls.

nodes.name: GalleryLightbox
nodes.summary: Full-screen lightbox for browsing image attachments with next/previous navigation.

nodes.name: MessageThread.jsx
nodes.summary: Message thread renderer for CV6: groups messages by sender, renders desktop and mobile message turns, attaches goal-thread bodies, result blocks, attachments, and link cards per message.
nodes.languageNotes: Provides parallel desktop (Cv6*) and mobile message-turn renderers sharing the same block/attachment components.

nodes.name: Cv6MessageThread
nodes.summary: Desktop message thread that renders sender-grouped message turns plus the live working turn from converted live steps.

nodes.name: Cv6MessageGroup
nodes.summary: Renders a group of consecutive messages from the same sender, including result blocks and link cards for agent turns.

nodes.name: Cv6MessageTurn
nodes.summary: Renders a single message turn (bubble) with its text content and any extras.

nodes.name: Cv6MessageExtras
nodes.summary: Renders the extras attached to a message — goal-thread body, attachments, and link cards — when present.

nodes.name: MobileMessageThread
nodes.summary: Mobile variant of the message thread rendering compact message turns and the live working turn.

nodes.name: ResultLinkCard.jsx
nodes.summary: Small component rendering a row of link preview cards (host + label) for URLs surfaced in an agent result.

nodes.name: ResultLinkCards
nodes.summary: Renders a set of link cards from an array of URL descriptors, deriving the display host from each URL.

nodes.name: useDictation.js
nodes.summary: React hook wrapping the browser SpeechRecognition API to provide push-to-talk dictation, emitting transcribed text to a callback.
nodes.languageNotes: Guards on the vendor-prefixed SpeechRecognition API and exports a dictationSupported capability flag.

nodes.name: useDictation
nodes.summary: Hook that starts/stops browser speech recognition and streams recognized text back through the onText callback.

nodes.name: Onboarding.jsx
nodes.summary: Responsive router for the CV6 first-run onboarding flow; mounts OnboardingDesktop or OnboardingMobile based on a viewport media query.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the app-wide 900px breakpoint (below 900 = mobile layout) via the useMediaQuery hook.

nodes.name: OnboardingDesktop.jsx
nodes.summary: Desktop onboarding screen that composes the wired HTML template with loading/error/empty states and binds real onboarding data plus step-progression actions via TemplateScreen.
nodes.languageNotes: Precomputes screen HTML at module load with DOMParser, injecting shared state blocks from states-extra.html.

nodes.name: OnboardingMobile.jsx
nodes.summary: Mobile onboarding screen that mounts the full-width onboarding template with a step indicator and binds real data plus back/skip/next progression via TemplateScreen.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors OnboardingDesktop's compose-and-bind pattern against the onboarding-mobile screen variant.

nodes.name: useOnboarding.js
nodes.summary: React hook backing the guided first-run onboarding flow: tracks auth, step index, and theme, and shapes the step/connection/agent/theme view model consumed by the desktop and mobile screens.
nodes.languageNotes: Theme selection is real (localStorage + Supabase auth), while connections, agent permissions, and goal creation are honest HELD-C placeholders shown as not-connected/off rather than faked.

nodes.name: Onboarding
nodes.summary: Default-exported component that reads the mobile media query and renders either OnboardingMobile or OnboardingDesktop, forwarding onNav and onOpenNav props.

nodes.name: composeOnboardingDesktop
nodes.summary: Parses the onboarding template, selects the named desktop screen, and appends shared loading/error/empty state blocks, returning the composed screen outerHTML.

nodes.name: OnboardingDesktop
nodes.summary: Default-exported desktop onboarding component that pulls onboarding state/data from useOnboarding and wires back/skip/next/theme actions into TemplateScreen, advancing to Home on the final step.

nodes.name: composeOnboardingMobile
nodes.summary: Parses the onboarding template, selects the named mobile screen, and appends shared loading/error/empty state blocks, returning the composed screen outerHTML.

nodes.name: OnboardingMobile
nodes.summary: Default-exported mobile onboarding component that pulls onboarding state/data from useOnboarding and wires back/skip/next/theme actions into TemplateScreen, advancing to Home on the final step.

nodes.name: useOnboarding
nodes.summary: Onboarding hook that watches Supabase auth, persists/reads theme from localStorage, tracks the step index, and memoizes the full view model (lead rail, progress dots, current step, connections, agents, themes) for the onboarding screens.

nodes.name: Settings.jsx
nodes.summary: Responsive router for the CV6 Settings screen that renders the desktop or mobile variant based on a media-query breakpoint.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Default-exported component that uses useMediaQuery to switch between SettingsDesktop and SettingsMobile.

nodes.name: SettingsDesktop.jsx
nodes.summary: Desktop variant of the CV6 Settings screen; composes the static HTML shell with live data from useSettings and wires nav, search, and theme controls.
nodes.languageNotes: Injects live data into a static HTML template by parsing it with DOMParser and stripping loading/error/empty placeholder states before appending real content.

nodes.name: composeSettingsDesktop
nodes.summary: Parses the raw settings HTML, extracts the named screen, removes the topbar and placeholder states, and appends live content nodes.

nodes.name: SettingsDesktop
nodes.summary: Default-exported desktop Settings component that loads settings data, tracks the active section, and handles nav, search, and theme persistence.

nodes.name: SettingsMobile.jsx
nodes.summary: Mobile variant of the CV6 Settings screen with a list/detail two-view flow; composes the static HTML shell with live data from useSettings.
nodes.languageNotes: Same DOMParser-based template composition as the desktop variant, plus a list-vs-detail view toggle for small screens.

nodes.name: composeSettingsMobile
nodes.summary: Parses the raw settings HTML, extracts the named screen, strips placeholder states, and appends live content for the mobile layout.

nodes.name: SettingsMobile
nodes.summary: Default-exported mobile Settings component managing list/detail view state, section selection, and nav/search/theme handling.

nodes.name: useSettings.js
nodes.summary: Data hook backing both Settings variants; loads the authenticated user, projects, and theme, and derives the settings view model consumed by the UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Subscribes to Supabase auth state changes and cross-tab theme updates via storage events, cleaning up both listeners on unmount.

nodes.name: useSettings
nodes.summary: React hook that fetches projects, tracks the current user and theme, and returns a memoized settings view model with derived user initials.

nodes.name: Campaign.jsx
nodes.summary: Mission-control screen for the Email > Campaign cold-outreach tool: a today-first dashboard combining a health strip, goal progress, pipeline stages, per-city detail, an activity feed, and a multi-step campaign creation wizard.
nodes.languageNotes: Single large JSX module holding one default-exported screen plus ~14 private presentational sub-components and helpers; all data comes through the useCampaign hooks.

nodes.name: EmailShell.jsx
nodes.summary: Segmented-tab shell for the Email tool that flips between the existing Inbox (Support) surface and the Campaign mission-control tool, persisting the active tab per session in sessionStorage.

nodes.name: useCampaign.js
nodes.summary: Data-fetching React hooks (authFetch + world param + interval polling) backing the Campaign tool: list, detail, health, contacts, city detail, activity feed, and a campaign-action mutator.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the useCommandTracker pattern; health polls fast (5s) with payload diffing to skip needless re-renders, detail polls slower (20s).

nodes.name: Campaign
nodes.summary: Top-level default-exported Campaign screen: wires the campaign data hooks, manages selected campaign/city/stage/wizard state, and composes the health strip, today cards, pipeline, city detail, and activity feed.

nodes.name: CreateWizard
nodes.summary: Multi-step wizard for creating a campaign: name and message template, audience selection (CSV upload or dataset filter with live preview), mail connection choice, and launch via authFetch.

nodes.name: MessageCard
nodes.summary: Editable template card that previews the campaign email against a sample contact, exposes merge fields, and saves subject/body edits via authFetch.

nodes.name: CityDetail
nodes.summary: Per-city detail panel showing merge fields, next-stage actions, recent replies, and a merged event/send timeline for a single contact.

nodes.name: TodayCards
nodes.summary: Today-first action cards surfacing replies to handle and follow-ups due, each carrying exactly one tap to act on it.

nodes.name: StageList
nodes.summary: Paginated contact list for a selected pipeline stage, showing city population figures with load-more support.

nodes.name: HealthStrip
nodes.summary: Health strip answering 'is it running?' in two seconds via a status light plus a one-tap fix for the current problem.

nodes.name: GoalStrip
nodes.summary: Goal progress strip rendering the campaign's completion percentage toward its target.

nodes.name: PipelineBar
nodes.summary: Horizontal pipeline bar rendering each ordered stage as a tappable segment that drills into its contact list.

nodes.name: ActivityFeed
nodes.summary: Recent-activity feed listing the latest campaign events with relative timestamps.

nodes.name: fmtWhen
nodes.summary: Formats an ISO timestamp into a friendly relative label (time today, 'Tomorrow', or short date), reused throughout the screen.

nodes.name: healthLine
nodes.summary: Builds the human-readable one-line summary describing the campaign's current health state and next scheduled action.

nodes.name: StatusLight
nodes.summary: Small colored status dot indicating the running/waiting/paused/problem state of a campaign.

nodes.name: EmailShell
nodes.summary: Segmented shell component switching between the Inbox and Campaign tabs, persisting the choice to sessionStorage and passing worldId into the Campaign tool.

nodes.name: useCampaignList
nodes.summary: Hook that loads the campaign list and setup state for a world and refreshes it on a polling interval.

nodes.name: useCampaignDetail
nodes.summary: Hook that fetches a single campaign's detail by id and world with periodic refresh.

nodes.name: useCampaignHealth
nodes.summary: Hook that fast-polls (5s) campaign health, diffing serialized payloads to avoid needless re-renders of the health strip.

nodes.name: useCampaignContacts
nodes.summary: Hook that fetches paginated campaign contacts filtered by stage, supporting append/load-more accumulation and totals.

nodes.name: useCityDetail
nodes.summary: Hook that loads a single contact/city's detail with a mounted-guard flag to discard stale async writes.

nodes.name: useCampaignActivity
nodes.summary: Hook that fetches the campaign activity feed for a world/campaign with periodic refresh.

nodes.name: useCampaignActions
nodes.summary: Hook returning a busy-tracked action dispatcher that POSTs campaign actions via authFetch and re-runs an onDone callback to refresh state.

nodes.name: chat-list.json
nodes.summary: Data-binding contract for the mobile chat-list screen, declaring the live/needs-you counts, the agent row shape (id, name, initials, tint, status), actions, states, and modifier rules the wired template fills with real data.
nodes.languageNotes: Not seed data but a CV6 template binding spec: it maps data-each/data-bind hooks in wired/mobile/chat-list.html to typed field shapes rather than holding concrete records.

nodes.name: chat.json
nodes.summary: Data-binding contract for the Chat Goal Thread tool across desktop and mobile, composing message blocks from the agent-chat kit and defining the rooms/agents/goal vocabulary, actions, and states the thread renders.

nodes.name: command.json
nodes.summary: Data-binding contract for the Command tool screen, describing the goal ledger, background-activity dock, and focused goal-detail regions plus their counts, actions, and states.

nodes.name: home-desktop.json
nodes.summary: Data-binding contract for the desktop Home screen, shaped to useHomeData: it declares the agents, projects, needs-you catch-up inbox, and conversation/goal column field shapes, actions, states, and responsive modifiers.

nodes.name: home-mobile.json
nodes.summary: Data-binding contract for the mobile Home screen, sharing the desktop Home rooms/agents/projects vocabulary and declaring the mobile-specific data shapes, actions, and states its wired template renders.

nodes.name: kit.json
nodes.summary: Element-kit contract for the shared agent-chat vocabulary, defining the reusable turn/message/block templates (avatar, status, stacked blocks, user reply bubble) cloned across Chat, Support, Command, and Live Scribe.
nodes.languageNotes: A component-vocabulary spec: each element carries a `what` description plus a typed `data.shape`, so consuming screens compose from one canonical set of chat block templates.

nodes.name: support-inbox.json
nodes.summary: Data-binding contract for the Support inbox tool, declaring the thread list, message shapes, tint enums, actions, states, and shared rules that useSupportInbox fills with the real support flow data.

nodes.name: tracker.json
nodes.summary: Data-binding contract for the Tracker tool (CV6 bug tracker), describing the desktop switcher/bug-table/detail regions and the mobile list, switch, and detail states with their bug row shapes and actions.

nodes.name: chat-list.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Chat list screen: an Agents section (avatar, live status dot, last-message snippet, needs-you count) and a Projects section (folder glyph, rollup status), with All/Agents/Projects/Needs-you filter chips; tapping a row opens the Goal Thread.
nodes.languageNotes: Wired template using data-each for repeating rows and data-mod="is-:path" for per-item status/tint modifiers; scoped under [data-cv6].

nodes.name: chat.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Chat / Goal Thread tool in both desktop (rooms rail, conversation thread, agent control drawer) and mobile layouts; the thread's step blocks (done, snag+decision, working, upcoming) compose from the shared agent-chat kit.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonical sample thread demonstrates the .step*/choice-card/pill-chip vocabulary; per-item lists use data-each, per-item visuals use data-mod="is-:path".

nodes.name: command.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Command tool: a goal ledger of every room's current goal, a background-activity dock aggregating running jobs, and a goal-detail panel that drives the master-loop (checklist, scheduled loops, master-loop watch); desktop + mobile.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavily annotated with wd40/Steffen design-round rationale; loop rows reuse astat status chips and cadence <select> primitives.

nodes.name: home-desktop.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the desktop Home surface (now two columns): an All Rooms rail with the agents/recently-active/projects-and-missions tree, plus the selected room's Conversation column; anchors the shared room/agent/mission vocabulary reused across every CV6 screen.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses data-cv6-keep anchors so React portals (Cv6QuickThread, composer, Files overlay) graft into stable host nodes across re-binds.

nodes.name: home-mobile.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Home surface across two navigation states: (A) Pick-up-where-you-left-off + All Rooms, and (B) a project opened to its general chat and mission list; shares the desktop Home room/mission data vocabulary.
nodes.languageNotes: Two mountable [data-cv6] screens in one file; retains layered background (bg1/bg2) and safe-area handling for the mobile frame.

nodes.name: kit.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup and reference kit for the agent-chat element vocabulary, labeled once: turn anatomy (avatar + stacked typed blocks), communication blocks (success / question / snag), data outputs and more, meant to be wired once and reused across Chat, Support, Command, and Live Scribe.
nodes.languageNotes: Each block is a labeled clone-source template; per-item variation via data-mod="is-:kind" on a base class that owns the look (no inline color).

nodes.name: livescribe.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Live Scribe tool: a live-capture surface with recording timer, animated waveform, and a start/stop capture button plus transcript turns; desktop and mobile screens.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps .capbtn styles inside the screen div because composeLiveScribe ships only the screen's outerHTML; head-level styles never reach the live page.

nodes.name: onboarding.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the guided first-run Onboarding flow through the Settings 'Environment' surface (connect sources → agents & permissions → theme → first goal → Home); desktop split layout plus mobile, with step content that swaps by current step.
nodes.languageNotes: Shares the Settings data model; Connect step wired as canonical, progress dots/bar reflect step.state.

nodes.name: organize.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Organize file tool: desktop project-tree → file-list → file-preview layout, and mobile browse+multi-select with a Move/Rename/Share/Delete action bar, a move-to-folder sheet, and a file view/review screen.
nodes.languageNotes: Reuses the same left-rail project/mission selection pattern that Review's queue uses; lists via data-each, per-item visuals via data-mod.

nodes.name: review.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Review tool: a deliverable queue (project→mission tree over the scoped deliverable list), a deliverable viewer with pin-comments, and an approve / request-changes decision panel; the viewer swaps by deliverable type (doc/photo/video/siteshot/sitelive), with the document viewer shown as canonical.
nodes.languageNotes: Viewer region is type-switched by deliverable.type; desktop queue→viewer→decision and mobile list→read→decide flows in one file.

nodes.name: settings.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Settings 'Environment' master surface: the connections list (email and other sources agents can act on), rooms & scope controls, and shared-room awareness messaging that governs which rooms and people can reach each connection.
nodes.languageNotes: Section nav swaps content by section; connection controls shown disabled ("coming soon") as a design placeholder.

nodes.name: states-extra.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the shared empty / loading / error state fragment reused by every CV6 tool; the same markup carries tool-specific copy through data-bind and is shown by swapping which data-state block renders, so tools never redraw these states themselves.
nodes.languageNotes: Bindable copy (empty/loading/error title+body) plus emptyAction/retry/viewOffline actions let one fragment serve all tools.

nodes.name: support-inbox.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Support inbox: a list of incoming emails/asks with avatar tints, status chips, and filter chips, delivered as the shippable device-content fragment (specimen framing and fake status bar stripped).
nodes.languageNotes: Pilot fill-in template with an inline wiring legend; empty/loading/error reuse the shared states.html fragment rather than redrawing.

nodes.name: support-thread.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the mobile Support email-thread view: the real original email (sender, body, time) bound from the tapped inbox item, an agent-summary card that shows real bullets or plainly states why not (pending/failed/needs-assign), expandable quoted history, and a reply-via-agent action held until the email becomes an ask.
nodes.languageNotes: Encodes an honesty contract: no fabricated bullets and no infinite spinner; reply only exists once a mailbox row becomes an ask.

nodes.name: tracker.html
nodes.summary: Static design mockup for the Tracker (bug) tool: desktop tracker switcher, bug table, and bug detail; mobile A) bug list with attachments and a live-agent strip, B) bug detail with assign-to-agent, and C) an agent-working-live view.
nodes.languageNotes: Lists via data-each; per-item bug status/priority visuals via data-mod="is-:path"; desktop + three mobile states in one file.

nodes.name: cv6.css
nodes.summary: The single-import CV6 stylesheet: design tokens (color scales, semantic surface/text/accent vars, radii, fonts), frame layout, and every screen-primitive class for the CV6 dashboard surface. Defines dark, light, and glass themes plus reduced-motion and per-screen variants, all scoped under [data-cv6].
nodes.languageNotes: All rules are namespaced under [data-cv6] and theme swaps flip [data-theme] (dark/light/glass) on the mount wrapper or [data-app-theme] on the app root, so a single import re-skins every screen without per-screen CSS.

nodes.name: PinLayer.jsx
nodes.summary: Interactive overlay layer for the CV6 viewer that lets users drop numbered comment pins by clicking empty space and re-open existing pins. Positioned absolutely over doc/image/video/website viewers via a crosshair-cursor wrapper.

nodes.name: PinLayer
nodes.summary: React function component that renders children plus a click-sensitive layer; on empty-space click it computes pin x/y offsets from the container's bounding rect and calls onAddPin, renders each pin as a numbered circle invoking onOpenPin, and shows a 'Click anywhere to comment' hint when no pins exist.

layers.name: Root & Navigation
layers.description: The CV6 root view-machine (CornerCV6) that routes to every screen, the shared responsive nav rail, and the persistent live-agent activity dock mounted in the shell.

layers.name: Screen Views
layers.description: Responsive screen components — Onboarding, Organize, Review, Settings, Support, Campaign, LiveScribe, Search and their router/Desktop/Mobile triads plus review-pin and tree-context overlays.

layers.name: Chat & Messaging
layers.description: The chat feature cluster: desktop/mobile chat orchestrators, goal-thread and block renderers, message thread and attachment views, composers, and result-link cards.

layers.name: Data Hooks & State
layers.description: The view-model wiring layer — use* React hooks, the shared DataContext provider, and document/media/link helper modules that feed real data and demo fixtures to the screens.

layers.name: Seed & Contract Data
layers.description: Static JSON UI-contract and seed files under data/ that define binding shapes and sample content for each screen (chat, home, command, tracker, support, kit).

layers.name: Design Templates
layers.description: Static HTML design mockups under templates/ — one reference per screen — that document the intended visual design and are not runtime code.

layers.name: Styling & Design Tokens
layers.description: The cv6.css stylesheet holding the CV6 design-token system, theming variables, and shared component styles imported by the shell.
